shared_elements: human figure(s) shown in low relief on stone
stylised patterned hair or headdress rendered as rows of curls/grid
garment rendered with incised parallel lines
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief carving of human-related imagery organised in horizontal zones, and both include a prominent disc-like circular motif and patterned, grid-like hair/headdress treatment, but that is about as far as the correspondence goes. A depicts a single frontal colossal figure with an emblem-like disc and abstract symbols on its body, while B shows a processional scene of profile figures in a register with a horse head and a rosette border below — different subjects, relationships and compositional logic.
